attrs.evidence: Eliminative argumentation's x|y is printed by §8 as a diagnostic and nothing consumes it. Two reasons it must stay a diagnostic, and the second is the sharper one. It is not a probability of correctness, a completeness measure, or comparable across projects. And optimizing for it would reward IDENTIFYING FEWER DOUBTS, since every new defeater lowers the ratio until it is closed — an artifact whose scoring function punishes writing doubts down would stop writing them down. R6 raised the identified count by 8 and closed 6; the ratio is not the point and is printed beside the sentence saying so.
attrs.prior_art: Goodenough, Weinstock & Klein CMU/SEI-2015-TR-005. GPT-5.6 adjudication §7.
attrs.statement: Confidence is reported as a triple — status, the derived label set with the Baconian x|y count, and the residual set — and is never collapsed to one scalar.
